name: BLINK
intro: BLINK是一个针对多模态大语言模型（LLMs）的新基准，专注于其他评估中未发现的核心视觉感知能力。它将14个经典的计算机视觉任务重新格式化为3,807个多项选择题，并配有单张或多张图像和视觉提示。BLINK旨在刺激社区帮助多模态LLMs赶上人类水平的视觉感知。
org: University of Pennsylvania, University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, University of California Davis, Columbia University
build_method: 经典视觉任务改写、既有数据集复用、新数据采集、人工去歧义质检
build_method_en: Classic-Vision Task Recasting, Dataset Reuse, New Data Collection, Manual Ambiguity Review
eval_feature_en: Zero-Shot, Visual Prompting, Single/Multi-Image, Human and Specialist Baselines
intro_en: BLINK is a new benchmark for multimodal large language models (LLMs) that focuses on core visual perception abilities not captured by other evaluations. It reformats 14 classic computer vision tasks into 3,807 multiple-choice questions, accompanied by single or multiple images and visual prompts. BLINK aims to encourage the community to help multimodal LLMs reach human-level visual perception.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2404.12390 and the ECCV 2024 paper: 14 named visual-perception tasks; reuse of HPatches, IIW, DIW, VSR, Wild6D, TARA, WikiArt, LVIS, TallyQA, DreamSim, SPair-71k, and FunKPoint; new SDXL-versus-matched-real-photo forensics data and license-friendly IQ items; task-specific points, frames, boxes, patches, counts, and annotations; multiple-choice recasting with single/multiple images and text/image answer options; circles, boxes, masks, and reference-point visual prompts; unique images plus manual ambiguity removal; the paper's exact 3,807 total with 1,901 validation and 1,906 test questions over about 7.3K images; temperature-zero evaluation with up to 10 retries and no resizing; predefined parsing plus GPT-3.5 fallback; 95.70% human reference accuracy; caption-only and prompt-sensitivity diagnostics; and overall/per-task comparisons against random, human, MLLM, and specialist baselines.
